subject.title: ci(release): add plugin npm artifact preflight

question: Should the release workflow adopt this trusted-main plugin npm preflight and its v2 evidence artifact as an official release-operator contract?
rationale: The implementation has no identified correctness defect, but accepting a new trusted workflow boundary and durable evidence schema requires release-owner intent rather than automated repair judgment.

options.title: Adopt the preflight boundary
options.body: Merge after current-head checks complete and release owners confirm the non-mutating trust model and evidence contract.

options.title: Keep proof outside publication workflow
options.body: Decline this route and continue producing package-byte evidence through existing release or Testbox tooling.

recommendation.title: Adopt the preflight boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after current-head checks complete and release owners confirm the non-mutating trust model and evidence contract.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS routes general workflow changes to this handle, with the release-manager team as the adjacent ownership group.
